models.qwen_languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian. Every voice supports all ten languages.

models.speech_fallback_hint: Use provider speech first; choose a fallback for providers without speech
models.dictionary_source_note: Pronunciations and extra examples: Free Dictionary. Example translations: Google.
models.title: Models and connections
models.privacy_hint: Blocks remote and loopback HTTP, ordinary plugins and unverified speech. Language detection is local. Switching invalidates pending results; data already sent cannot be recalled. Explicit model downloads contain no translation text.
models.no_services: No eligible services. Open Settings → Models and connections to install a supported direction, configure a service or review device-only policy.
models.local_description: Lightweight bilingual OPUS-MT with embedded CTranslate2 int8. About 82.5 MB per direction. Downloads are explicit and versions are pinned. Services run in parallel; ordering chooses the primary result. No automatic cloud fallback.
models.add_model: Add local model / device and license check
models.memory_unknown: Memory requirement cannot be estimated on this device. A previous en→zh measurement was about 158 MB at 4 threads on one benchmark device; this is not a guarantee for both directions. Reserve 400 MB of disk space.
models.accept_license: I have reviewed the source and licenses: Apache-2.0 and CC-BY-4.0 (attribution: Helsinki-NLP / OPUS-MT)
models.enable_after: Enable after installation (privacy mode stays unchanged)
models.install_complete: Both directions verified and self-tested. Service added.
models.use_direction: Add verified direction as a service
models.delete_model: Delete model files (affects all referencing instances)
models.cancel_retains: Pause or cancel stops transfer; temporary files are retained for explicit resume. Restart never silently resumes downloads. Resume can restart a file if its server validator changed.
models.status_failed: Could not inspect model status. Retry in Settings.
models.existing: Existing connection (keeps its instance ID and advanced settings)
models.rebind: Leave blank to keep existing binding; enter to rebind
models.proxy_hint: Uses the application/webview network stack; system proxy may apply. HTTPS is required outside loopback. Cross-origin redirects are rejected. Credentials are excluded from exports; unavailable bindings need to be re-entered. No plaintext fallback.
models.voice_unavailable: System speech is unavailable on this platform/device
models.voice_help: Reuse installed system speech in Settings → Services → TTS → Local speech. Existing TTS defaults are preserved. macOS uses say; Linux needs espeak-ng/espeak for verified offline synthesis. Windows speech is not implemented.
models.glossary_hint: Source match and literal output checks for all text engines. OpenAI/Ollama also receive preferences for matched terms. No forced replacement; missing terms do not prove a translation is wrong. Code, URLs and email are excluded from matching.
models.edit_entries: Edit existing entries as JSON (keep IDs)
models.import_editor: Edit entries / paste CSV or JSON
models.strategy_skip: Keep existing IDs, add new entries
models.conflict_help: Resolve conflicts in the editor before confirming: keep one entry per conflicting ID, or use an existing ID to explicitly update its term. Preview shows the first 200 rows; all rows are validated.
models.hint_limit: Prompt preferences were limited to 32 terms / 4000 characters.
models.anonymous: Allow a connection without an API key (only when your server permits it)
models.export_safe: Exports exclude credentials, headers and unclassified plugin settings. Rebind credentials on the destination device.
models.model_summary: English ↔ Simplified Chinese · ~165 MB total · offline
models.google_blocked: Device-only mode blocks Google speech and dictionary lookup.
models.google_network: Sends the text to Google for speech.
models.system_installed: Uses installed system voices; no text is sent to Google.
models.speech_choice_hint: Provider speech takes priority. Choose fallback speech here; Google uses the network, local services synthesize on this device.
models.model_dictionary_note: Dictionary details generated by this model; IPA may be inaccurate.
models.dictionary_network_hint: Look up Google and the English dictionary for pronunciations and examples.

models.piper_scope_note: The HTML prototype included Piper voice downloads. The v2 launch scope defers Piper until runtime, voice files and licenses are verified. Only system speech is available in this release.
models.multi_summary: Multilingual · one 496 MB download · offline CPU inference
models.multi_scope_short: Japanese, Korean, French, German and more
models.multi_scope_hint: Download once, then select source and target in the translation window. Covers 27 current language options. Portuguese regional variants are not distinguished. Traditional Chinese output, traditional Mongolian and Nynorsk are unsupported.
models.multi_one_download: One model shared by all supported directions
models.multi_disk: Reserve 1.2 GB for staging and repair
models.multi_memory: Recommended: a computer with 8 GB RAM or more. CPU only, no dedicated GPU required. Slower than OPUS; latency and memory use depend on your device and text length.
models.multi_install_subtitle: Download one quantized model and choose languages in the translation window.
models.multi_license_ack: I have read the model source and MIT license

models.catalog_pick_folder: Choose an extracted CTranslate2 model directory
models.catalog_import_hint: Import an extracted directory. Files are copied to managed storage; originals are preserved. Files must match the selected catalog model/version. Arbitrary GGUF, PyTorch, ONNX, archives and fine-tuned weights are unsupported.
models.catalog_compatibility: Only integrated, usable models are listed. Imports and mirrors cannot add architectures or language capabilities. Other local LLMs can use an OpenAI-compatible / Ollama connection.
models.catalog_remove_hint: Remove only this model’s managed files, legacy copies and staging task. Service settings, history and import originals are preserved. Download or import again to restore.

models.kokoro_service_hint: 82M INT8 · shared weights · seven languages, many voices
models.kokoro_speech_failed: Kokoro could not speak this language. Check that its model is installed and this language has a voice preference (up to 3,000 characters).
models.qwen_dependencies_detail: Requires Python 3.10–3.12, PyTorch, torchaudio, Transformers 4.57.3, accelerate, audio libraries and qwen-tts 0.1.1. Installation includes the environment as well as model weights. The app manages startup; this inference path needs neither FlashAttention nor system SoX.
models.qwen_memory: At least {{size}} GB RAM recommended. Uses available Apple GPU / CUDA / CPU; CPU synthesis is slower.
models.qwen_checking_environment: Checking installed Python, dependency versions and actual imports. No downloads yet…
models.qwen_model_download: Model files: {{size}}. Complete verified cached files will be reused.
models.qwen_reuse_full: Reuse a complete compatible environment; no dependency installation.
models.qwen_reuse_python: Reuse detected Python and create a separate application environment.
models.qwen_download_python: No compatible Python found. Download Python 3.12 and create an application environment automatically.
models.qwen_dependency_estimate: Approximately 0.2–1.5 GB for PyTorch and audio libraries, depending on platform and cache. Python runtime is additional if missing.
models.qwen_reuse_safety: Checks versions and actual imports. Complete compatible environments are reused; missing dependencies go into an application environment without modifying existing packages.
models.qwen_platform_unsupported: A supported Qwen / PyTorch runtime is not available on this platform.
models.qwen_disk_insufficient: Insufficient disk space for model and runtime dependencies.
models.qwen_download_ack: I have reviewed model and dependency downloads, sources and licenses (Qwen · Apache-2.0).
models.qwen_install_verified: Installed, files verified and real speech synthesis passed.
models.qwen_install_plan: Start installation to prepare the checked runtime, download and verify the model, then test synthesis. Retry resumes retained downloads.
models.qwen_autostart_hint: The app starts and reuses the inference process when speaking. Unload it to release memory; it stops when the app exits. Initial loading and synthesis take time; up to 2000 characters per request.
models.qwen_stage_dependencies: Installing PyTorch, Qwen and audio dependencies
models.qwen_stage_warming: Loading model and testing real speech
models.native_install_intro: Check the device and runtime before starting installation.
models.native_runtime_reuse: Reuse the native runtime bundled with the app. No Python or separate environment is required.
models.native_dependencies_included: Runtime included; no extra dependency downloads
models.native_install_plan: Checks passed. Start installation to download, verify and test the model before enabling it.
